destination.title: String cosmology, cosmic strings and their observational reach
destination.question: What can string theory, explicitly string-inspired models and cosmic-string physics establish about cosmic histories, primordial structure, matter sectors and observable signals, under their distinct assumptions and limits of control?
destination.summary: The supplied contrasts support several connected research directions: dilaton and winding dynamics, inflation and vacuum energy, thermal perturbation production, and field-theory string formation and network evolution. The attributed child scopes extend these directions to stabilization, singularities, quantum descriptions and qualified neighboring systems. Numerical ancestry does not establish final scientific parentage.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: Does network scaling extend to loop production, and is its small-scale cutoff set by gravity or microscopic thickness? Finite dynamic range and unresolved disagreement between Nambu and field-theory simulations prevent a controlled quantitative answer.

sources.title: Producing a scale-invariant spectrum of perturbations in a Hagedorn phase of string cosmology

evidence.text: Can thermal fluctuations of a closed-string gas in an early Hagedorn phase generate nearly scale-invariant cosmological perturbations, followed by ordinary radiation domination, without an intervening period of inflation?

sources.title: Elements of string cosmology

evidence.text: How does dynamical dilaton evolution make string cosmology compatible with large–small radius duality, alter winding-mode backreaction, and connect critical-string radiation evolution with noncritical two-dimensional cosmologies?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Can the tensor and scalar predictions of DBI inflation satisfy compactification geometry and cosmological observations simultaneously, with constraints insensitive to the detailed potential and throat profile?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a spacetime big bang be described by gauge degrees of freedom that become tractable when the string geometry fails? The reviewed null linear-dilaton construction exchanges early strong string coupling for weak worldvolume Yang–Mills coupling.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: What replaces the classical description of a spacelike singularity in string theory, and can the associated divergences or closed timelike curves be controlled? The review compares several partial approaches without asserting a complete resolution.

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Can explicitly computed interactions between a mobile D3-brane and moduli-stabilizing wrapped branes be fine-tuned to permit slow-roll warped brane inflation, while keeping the inflationary region inside a geometrically controlled throat?

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Can D7-embedding-dependent threshold corrections cancel moduli-stabilization forces on a mobile D3-brane sufficiently to realize inflation driven by D3–anti-D3 Coulomb attraction? If cancellation is only local, can inflation occur and can the brane reach the tip?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a simple symmetric wrapped-brane embedding yield a stable radial path with locally small inflaton curvature? The Kuperstein cycle supplies an explicit holomorphic prefactor and a residual SO(3) symmetry.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a mobile D3-brane inflate after volume stabilization, wrapped-brane forces and geometric parameter correlations are included? The target is a construction derived from compactification data, with sufficient control to assess inflation and its predictions.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: How reliably can observations identify cosmic strings and determine their properties when loop formation sizes are poorly known? The paper treats the macroscopic network-to-observation problem, with particular emphasis on gravitational radiation.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: The model isolates uncertainties in string-network evolution by restricting the microscopic possibilities to one stable, purely gravitational string species. The dimensionless tension Gµ controls its gravitational strength.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can a brane with relativistic local motion drive inflation through warping even when ordinary potential slow-roll conditions fail?

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Can a relativistic D5- or D7-brane wrapped on an internal cycle generate allowed inflationary observables within a stabilized warped compactification?

sources.title: Large Gravitational Waves and Lyth Bound in Multi Brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can interacting brane-position moduli produce an effective inflaton? In the reviewed heterotic construction, neighboring open-M2 instantons couple N M5-branes, and equal adjacent separations are reported to form a stable attractor.

sources.title: Monodromy in the CMB: Gravity Waves and String Inflation

evidence.text: Can wrapped-brane monodromy provide super-Planckian single-field inflation in string theory while preserving moduli stabilization and suppressing corrections to slow roll, with an observable tensor signal?

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: When can light residual angular fields generate significant curvature perturbations and non-Gaussianity at the end of warped brane inflation, and do those conditions actually produce an effect in the explicit Kuperstein-embedding case study?

sources.title: Warped Wilson Line DBI Inflation

evidence.text: Can a Wilson-line inflaton with DBI kinetic terms in a warped compactification satisfy theoretical and cosmological consistency bounds while producing both substantial non-Gaussianity and observable tensor perturbations?

sources.title: Abelian Higgs Cosmic Strings: Small Scale Structure and Loops

evidence.text: How do small-scale structure, loop production and massive radiation distribute energy in Abelian Higgs cosmic-string networks, and how can these networks scale without gravitational radiation?

sources.title: Combined local and equilateral non-Gaussianities from multifield DBI inflation

evidence.text: Can angular fluctuations modulate the tachyonic end of radial D-brane inflation, generating curvature perturbations with both local and equilateral bispectra, and does their coexistence predict a distinctive trispectrum component?

sources.title: Low-scale Inflation and Supersymmetry Breaking in Racetrack Models

evidence.text: Can a single-modulus racetrack model support inflation with Hinf∼m3/2∼30–50 TeV, acceptable primordial perturbations and early gravitino decay, and what constraints would this place on visible-sector soft masses?

sources.title: Gauged M-flation, its UV sensitivity and Spectator Species

evidence.text: Does the light spectator spectrum lower the gravitational cutoff enough to invalidate gauged M-flation, and are its scalar inflationary trajectories stable within the proposed D-brane-motivated effective description?

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: Given incomplete knowledge of string theory, how reliably can string constructions describe the observed universe, and how much can cosmological observations constrain string theory itself?

sources.title: Modulated Reheating and Large Non-Gaussianity in String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can an explicit string-inflation construction support a light field that modulates visible-sector reheating, dominates primordial curvature perturbations, and produces appreciable local non-Gaussianity while avoiding curvaton contributions?

sources.title: Fluxbranes: Moduli Stabilisation and Inflation

evidence.text: Can fluxbrane inflation be combined with controlled moduli stabilization while satisfying the paper's historical curvature-perturbation and cosmic-string constraints, preserving an inflaton flat direction and avoiding an effectively constant FI term?

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: How do string-inflation models fare against Planck 2013 constraints on spectral tilt, primordial tensors, non-Gaussianity and dark radiation, and what does their theoretical control suggest about future tensor searches?

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Symmetry and Aharonov-Bohm Radiation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can radiation of Standard Model particles from dynamical Aharonov–Bohm strings associated with discrete gauge symmetries constrain string compactification parameters through cosmological energy injection?

sources.title: D7-Brane Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Can a D7-brane position modulus realize large-field monodromy inflation in a four-dimensional supergravity description while conventional flux and nonperturbative effects stabilize the remaining moduli?

sources.title: D7-Brane Moduli Space in Axion Monodromy and Fluxbrane Inflation

evidence.text: Under what geometric, flux, and quantum-correction conditions can a D7-brane deformation remain sufficiently light for inflation, and can fluxbrane inflation coexist parametrically with Kähler-moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: Can the neutral MSSM Higgs sector drive chaotic-like inflation through string monodromy, while leaving a fine-tuned light SM Higgs and controlling corrections during trans-Planckian field excursions?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the displacement–tensor relation along the actual trajectory, then compare the excursion with an independently bounded field interval. For an observable interval with nearly constant r, replace the integral by √(r_*/8)Δ𝒩_*.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Transfer a known electric-field oscillator realization to the twisted closed-string algebra, specifying the Hilbert space and ordering. This operation addresses fixed-background quantization; it supplies neither a unique spacetime vacuum nor a backreacted singularity resolution.

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Use the imported position-dependent superpotential W=W0+A(z)e^−aρ, with a=2π/n and A(z)=A0[f(z)/f(0)]^(1/n), together with K=−3 log U and U=ρ+ρ̄−γk. The local conifold Kähler potential is k=3r²/2; the resulting F-term potential is supplemented by the anti-D3 contribution.

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Compute the N=1 supergravity F-term potential and extremize the axion, volume and angular directions for a general embedding. Large-volume expansion gives the leading angular condition ∂α|f|=0; the uplift and D3 displacement shift the volume minimum.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the known throat contribution to a gluing cutoff, then parameterize inaccessible bulk geometry. This gives leading-volume relations; interpreting a fluxed D7 gauge coupling additionally requires checking its magnetic contribution.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: Use measured or modeled long-string scaling to infer the energy available to all loops. Then distribute that energy among sizes and propagate each population according to its lifetime and redshift history.

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Cosmic strings

evidence.text: Review which field theories support cosmic strings, how strings form and evolve cosmologically, and whether their gravitational and other interactions yield distinguishable observational signatures.

sources.title: Don't panic! Closed string tachyons in ALE space-times

evidence.text: What is the fate of closed-string tachyons localized at noncompact nonsupersymmetric orbifold fixed points, under both worldsheet RG flow and on-shell time evolution? Can their condensation reach flat space or supersymmetric ALE geometries while remaining weakly coupled?

sources.title: String theory dynamics in various dimensions

evidence.text: What controls string theories at strong coupling in dimensions d≥4, and can higher-dimensional dynamics explain four-dimensional S-duality?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: How far can duality twists extend across string theories, fiber geometries, and twisted sectors while retaining controlled low-energy physics?

sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: When can a continuous family connecting black Dp-branes to static Kaluza-Klein bubbles represent a physical decay, and can winding closed-string tachyon condensation provide the mechanism and a stable static endpoint?

sources.title: Charge multiplets and masses for E(11)

evidence.text: Can decomposition of the E11 l1 charge representation organize lower-dimensional brane multiplets and supply an algebraic mass/tension formula consistent with known U-duality spectra?

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: What is the simplest conventional-matter brane with maximally symmetric stress-energy and spin that probes spacetime torsion, and what effective string coupling results when such a membrane wraps a small compact dimension?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local String Models

evidence.text: How do bulk-volume-dependent gauge thresholds change the apparent unification scale of local brane models, and can they alleviate the tension between intermediate string scales motivated by supersymmetry breaking and the historically inferred supersymmetric unification scale near 10^16 GeV?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric D1/D5 and F/NS5 supergravity families interpolate between black configurations and KK bubbles, and under what stability and validity conditions can these interpolations model closed-string tachyon condensation?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local Orientifolds

evidence.text: When do gauge thresholds in local orientifold models behave as running from the string scale or the bulk winding scale, and how can the string calculation agree with the Kaplunovsky–Louis supergravity expression?

sources.title: An Invitation to Higher Gauge Theory

evidence.text: How does parallel transport extend from particles along paths to strings over surfaces, using Lie 2-groups and 2-connections, and how does this framework organize examples from gerbes, BF theory and string theory?

sources.title: String background fields and Riemann-Cartan geometry

evidence.text: Can relaxing the compact-direction stress-energy symmetry of a wrapped classical spinning membrane produce effective-string couplings matching all four background fields Gμν, Bμν, Aμ and Φ of the string sigma model?

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordisms in General Relativity and String Theory

evidence.text: Can uniform, nonaccelerating expansion support controlled spatial interpolations between different effective string theories and compactifications, including changes in worldsheet orientability, while maintaining causal contact?

sources.title: Non-Perturbative Topological Strings And Conformal Blocks

evidence.text: How can topological strings with dual open descriptions receive nonperturbative completions, and how should the resulting contour-dependent blocks map to Liouville conformal blocks in the logarithmic-matrix-model realization of AGT?

sources.title: A comment on continuous spin representations of the Poincare group and perturbative string theory

evidence.text: Do the massless continuous-spin representations allowed by Poincaré representation theory occur in perturbative string spectra, and can their absence provide a general low-energy consequence of standard string constructions?

sources.title: Towards a classification of branes in theories with eight supercharges

evidence.text: Can single half-BPS branes in supergravities with eight supercharges and coset scalar manifolds be classified through the reality properties of charge-representation weights, and how do their counts relate to wrapping rules and central charges?

sources.title: Double Field Theory on Group Manifolds

evidence.text: Can closed string field theory around WZW group-manifold backgrounds yield a generalized DFT, clarify which constraints ensure gauge closure, and provide candidate string uplifts of non-geometric configurations?

sources.title: Geometry of Membrane Sigma Models

evidence.text: How can generalized geometry be extended to encode bosonic, gauge-fixed membrane sigma models, their Nambu sigma-model descriptions, and transformations underlying membrane open-closed relations?

sources.title: From Type II string theory toward BSM/dark sector physics

evidence.text: Which gauge representations, axions and massive gauge bosons can supply BSM/dark sectors in controlled string compactifications, and how reliably can their four-dimensional effective interactions be derived? This is a review of explicitly accessible constructions.

sources.title: Closed Superstring Field Theory and its Applications

evidence.text: How can closed superstring field theory systematically handle vacuum shifts, mass renormalization and S-matrix divergences, while establishing gauge independence and unitarity?

sources.title: A Solution to the Decompactification Problem in Chiral Heterotic Strings

evidence.text: Can chiral heterotic strings with two large dimensions and Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking avoid gauge thresholds growing linearly with internal volume, so that a Kaluza–Klein scale far below the string scale need not destroy perturbative gauge couplings?

sources.title: String Theory of Supertubes

evidence.text: Can exact worldsheet descriptions of supertubes expose near-source topology hidden by supergravity smearing and identify wrapped-brane degrees of freedom relevant to the long-string sector and approach to the black-hole threshold?

sources.title: A string theory which isn’t about strings

evidence.text: Can closed bosonic string theory be canonically quantized over a left-right asymmetric vacuum so that its physical spectrum contains finitely many fields, and what happens to scattering, unitarity and the one-loop vacuum amplitude?

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Which sector of a supersymmetric worldsheet theory can be made insensitive to the worldsheet metric and used to calculate geometric data?

sources.title: de Sitter Extrema and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a solution of source-integrated supergravity equations have a fully localized counterpart with the required orientifold and brane backreaction?

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Does a state-dependent instability persist in controlled time-dependent string backgrounds, and can dualities relate its loop and nonperturbative descriptions?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Does the order-one tachyon bound survive when the unstable mode overlaps the volume of an orientifold-wrapped cycle rather than lying entirely in the universal volume–dilaton sector?

sources.title: Non-geometric backgrounds in string theory

evidence.text: How are non-geometric string configurations constructed and described through T-duality, torus fibrations, generalised and doubled geometry, and what effects do their fluxes have on compactification and closed-string algebraic structures?

sources.title: Spin-2 fields and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Does a string spectrum containing massive spin-2 states establish a universal cutoff for an isolated neutral tensor?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How does an extended string acquire a field-theoretic description? Its embedding coordinates become scalar fields on a two-dimensional worldsheet, and the spacetime metric becomes their sigma-model field-space metric.

sources.title: A Note on the dS Swampland Conjecture, Non‐BPS Branes and K‐Theory

evidence.text: Does the de Sitter swampland conjecture require cancellation of torsional D-brane charge on compact spaces? The proposed test uses the positive tension of an isolated non-BPS D7-brane in a flux-stabilized Type IIA orientifold.

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Transport reference R-R polyforms, differentiate, and match operator coefficients. Restrict outputs to one lower/base index per flux; unrestricted generalized fluxes and R flux are not supplied.

sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: The proposed tachyon transition is tested by matching charge, transverse horizon/bubble size and asymptotic circle length in controlled limits. Chargeless F-strings are inferred by matching a neutral specialization of the intersecting solutions to another F-string/Dp-brane family.

sources.title: Charge multiplets and masses for E(11)

evidence.text: Delete Dynkin nodes, project roots onto finite-subalgebra weight spaces and orthogonal directions, and impose integer root coefficients, index constraints, connected support and allowed squared lengths.

sources.title: Test membranes in Riemann-Cartan spacetimes

evidence.text: Apply previously derived single-pole world-sheet equations and boundary conditions to a specified membrane spin ansatz. The authors then obtain action functionals producing the membrane and dimensionally reduced string equations.

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local String Models

evidence.text: The string analysis extracts the O(B²) vacuum-energy term in a background magnetic field. It evaluates annulus amplitudes using Chan–Paton traces, spin-structure sums and theta identities; modular transformations and a toroidal lattice sum expose the closed-string tadpole interpretation and bulk cutoff.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Start from a non-supersymmetric type IIA D0/D4 intersection, solve for a transverse delocalization creating an isometry, and T-dualize to D1/D5. Unlike BPS arrays, this delocalization cannot rely on a no-force construction.

sources.title: Exotic Branes in String Theory

evidence.text: How should exotic branes, their monodromy charges and charge conservation be understood, and how can ordinary brane bound states generate non-geometric configurations relevant to black hole microphysics?

sources.title: On the Existence of Meta-stable Vacua in Klebanov-Strassler

evidence.text: Do anti-D3 branes at the bottom of Klebanov-Strassler source a backreaction compatible with a metastable vacuum of the same supersymmetric field theory, or do their infrared boundary conditions require ultraviolet deformations of the theory?

sources.title: Gauge It or Break It: Lectures on Global Symmetries and the Cobordism Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the absence of exact global symmetries constrain quantum-gravity backgrounds, and what structures, defects and dynamical transitions does the Cobordism Conjecture require?

destination.title: Moduli stabilization, de Sitter construction and their limits
destination.question: Under which model-specific conditions can string/M-theory compactifications and related supergravity theories stabilize moduli, support metastable nonnegative-energy vacua, and retain control and cosmological viability?
destination.summary: This is a family of related questions, not one mechanism or an established existence claim. Different compactifications, uplift sectors, stability criteria and cosmological targets remain distinct. No original scientific scope statement was supplied beyond candidate numerical membership.

systems: Type IIB and type IIA compactifications
targets: Moduli stabilization and metastable de Sitter or Minkowski vacua
Geometric stability conditions and consistent uplifting
Correction control, backreaction and effective descriptions
Vacuum survival, thermal evolution and statistical distributions
regimes: Source-specific flux, nonperturbative, no-scale, large-volume and warped regimes
Zero-temperature vacua and separately identified thermal histories
assumptions: Construction and control assumptions are local to each source
Necessary conditions, sufficient conditions and explicit realizations are separate targets
Conjectures enter as conditional comparisons, not accepted constraints
conventions: Positive-energy saddles are distinguished from metastable minima
Perturbative stability is distinguished from tunneling lifetime
Geometric uplift is distinguished from vacuum-energy uplift
excludes: Localized BGHHS charge as a de Sitter stabilization mechanism
Universal existence or exclusion claims inferred from individual models
Certification of microscopic control from abstracts or retrieval descriptions

sources.title: Uplifting Anti-D6-brane

evidence.text: Can a type IIA STU effective model stabilize all moduli in a supersymmetric AdS minimum using only six-form flux and nonperturbative terms, then admit a metastable de Sitter uplift from anti-D6-branes?

sources.title: Topological constraints in the LARGE-volume scenario

evidence.text: How do topology and orientifold/brane data constrain simultaneous suppression of corrections in LVS de Sitter vacua, and is a large D3 tadpole alone sufficient?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua from an anomalous gauge symmetry

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux and anomaly-induced FI terms, a moduli-dependent gauge kinetic function and a gauge-invariant nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter or Minkowski vacua without additional low-energy uplift fields?

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can vector bundle moduli provide sufficient F-term uplift to stabilize supersymmetry-breaking Minkowski or de Sitter vacua in heterotic M-theory, including when the tree-level superpotential is constant?

sources.title: De Sitter from T-branes

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector F-term uplifting induced by D-term stabilization be understood by expanding a higher-dimensional D7 theory around a supersymmetric T-brane background, and can the resulting contribution support de Sitter LVS minima?

sources.title: F-term uplifting and moduli stabilization consistent with Kahler invariance

evidence.text: How can two supergravity sectors be coupled so that F-term uplifting preserves moduli supersymmetric critical points and shift symmetries, while retaining stability under Minkowski or de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: Single-step de Sitter vacua from nonperturbative effects with matter

evidence.text: Can coupled closed-string moduli and matter fields produce single-step metastable de Sitter stabilization through a pure F-term potential, without assuming that the axiodilaton and complex structure were already stabilized at a higher scale?

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can backreaction flatten an uplifted supersymmetric AdS potential enough to exclude metastable de Sitter vacua? The paper tests particular ten-dimensional arguments and four-dimensional KKLT models, including extreme backreaction parameters.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetry-breaking uplift produce a metastable de Sitter vacuum after the compactification volume, three-form fluxes and D7 gaugino condensate respond? The paper compares four-dimensional effective potentials with integrated ten-dimensional curvature constraints.

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Do general LVS correction sensitivities and the control obstruction in one explicit model prevent controlled dS vacua throughout the LVS class?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from perturbative Kahler corrections and consistent D-terms

evidence.text: Can perturbative Kähler stabilization of the volume modulus be combined with a gauge-consistent D-term uplift to obtain metastable de Sitter vacua in type IIB flux compactifications?

sources.title: Evidence for a bound on the lifetime of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Do antibrane-uplifted KKLT de Sitter vacua satisfy a Boltzmann-Brain-motivated upper lifetime bound, despite the ability to make supersymmetry breaking exponentially small, and how controlled is the construction?

sources.title: Kaluza–Klein tower and bubble nucleation in six dimensional Einstein–Maxwell theory

evidence.text: How do flux and uplift control KK masses, curvature-scale separation, and Minkowski limits, and does KK-tower descent obstruct flux-bubble transitions to ‘nothing’ or constrain metastable de Sitter vacua through the distance and cobordism conjectures?

sources.title: 4D models of de Sitter uplift

evidence.text: Do proposed backreaction modifications of four-dimensional KKLT preserve a consistent nilpotent-superfield description, and do consistent versions admit metastable de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Stable vacua with realistic phenomenology and cosmology in heterotic M-theory satisfying Swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can a heterotic M-theory stabilization protocol yield stable or long-lived vacua with realistic particle phenomenology and ΛCDM-compatible vacuum energy, subject to unresolved compactification inputs and the Swampland tests considered?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Which intersection structures admit the ordinary LVS hierarchy without forcing another physical cycle below the string scale?

sources.title: Control Problem of de Sitter Vacua with T-brane Uplift

evidence.text: Can T-brane uplifting produce self-consistent LVS de Sitter vacua with suppressed string and backreaction corrections, once uplift normalization, topology, tadpoles and brane-moduli stabilization are included?

sources.title: Decoupling and de Sitter Vacua in Approximate No-Scale Supergravities

evidence.text: When can small superpotential deformations lift no-scale Minkowski vacua to metastable de Sitter vacua, while keeping the number of stability tunings independent of the number of chiral fields?

sources.title: Statistical Distribution of the Vacuum Energy Density in Racetrack Kähler Uplift Models in String Theory

evidence.text: Can adding a second non-perturbative term to Kähler uplift relax the compactification-volume bound, produce controlled metastable de Sitter vacua, and statistically favor small positive vacuum energy?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can warped type IIB flux compactifications stabilize all moduli, then admit controlled supersymmetry breaking that produces metastable de Sitter vacua? Can their lifetimes exceed cosmological times while remaining below the de Sitter recurrence time?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua — when are ‘subleading corrections’ really subleading?

evidence.text: Can candidate weakly warped LVS de Sitter vacua remain consistent after expected string-loop, curvature and warping corrections are included, considering their effects on moduli vevs and vacuum energy as well as the off-shell potential?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from uplifting D-terms in effective supergravities from realistic strings

evidence.text: Can an anomalous U(1) D-term consistently uplift AdS minima to de Sitter or Minkowski vacua once gauge invariance, charged matter and the supergravity relation between F- and D-terms are included?

sources.title: Consistent de Sitter string vacua from Kahler stabilization and D-term uplifting

evidence.text: Can perturbative Kähler stabilization of the volume modulus be combined with magnetized-D7 D-term uplifting to obtain metastable de Sitter vacua while respecting four-dimensional supergravity and gauge-invariance constraints?

sources.title: Thermal effects and finite-temperature cosmology in perturbatively stabilized large volume scenarios

evidence.text: How do finite-temperature effects reshape perturbatively stabilized large-volume vacua, set decompactification and reheating bounds, and affect modulus domination and the eventual recovery or decay of the zero-temperature vacuum?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from Nonperturbative Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a moduli-dependent nonperturbative superpotential stabilize the modeled type IIB moduli simultaneously in a metastable de Sitter vacuum, without a separate explicitly supersymmetry-breaking uplift?

sources.title: Constraints from de Sitter metastability in heterotic string compactifications

evidence.text: How does the known sGoldstino necessary condition for metastable de Sitter vacua constrain heterotic Calabi–Yau compactifications when more than two Kähler moduli break supersymmetry, especially for three-dimensional moduli spaces?

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Can an LVS compactification with two Kähler moduli, a conifold modulus and anti-brane uplift admit dS vacua whose unknown corrections are parametrically negligible?

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can Kähler uplifting yield an analytic sufficient condition, expressed through flux and compactification data, for metastable de Sitter vacua with small positive vacuum energy, spontaneously broken supersymmetry and stabilized moduli?

sources.title: Joint statistics of cosmological constant and SUSY breaking in flux vacua with nilpotent Goldstino

evidence.text: How are the gravitino mass and cosmological constant jointly distributed in KKLT and LVS flux vacua when both moduli stabilization and warped anti-D3 uplift are incorporated, sampling only stabilized vacua?

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: How long does an uplifted string/M-theory de Sitter vacuum survive against tunneling toward infinite-volume decompactification when no additional local minimum remains after uplift?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with a positive cosmological constant in heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can anti-five-branes uplift stabilized heterotic M-theory vacua to metastable, supersymmetry-breaking vacua with a small positive cosmological constant, while preserving observable-bundle slope stability?

sources.title: A new de Sitter solution with a weakly warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: Can a weakly warped conifold in LVS support a metastable de Sitter vacuum with stabilized moduli and the stated effective-theory controls?

sources.title: Maximal temperature in flux compactifications

evidence.text: Under what conditions does a thermal plasma destabilize a compactification modulus, and what maximal early-universe temperature follows when this mechanism is applied to KKLT flux compactifications?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from a D-term Generated Racetrack Uplift

evidence.text: Can a D-term relation between two small Kähler moduli generate an F-term racetrack uplift from an LVS AdS minimum to metastable de Sitter, while keeping the D-term potential zero and avoiding additional warping or dilaton suppression?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from Kahler uplifting

evidence.text: Can the leading perturbative α′ correction and a nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter vacua at large volume and weak coupling, using spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking without an additional uplifting sector?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can microscopic vacua vary their cosmological constant independently of the gravitino mass, and would one or two towers govern those limits? The paper leaves this question open.

sources.title: Heterotic de Sitter beyond modular symmetry

evidence.text: Which branches of two-modulus heterotic orbifold effective theories forbid metastable de Sitter vacua, and can inherently stringy corrections of strength O(exp(-1/gs)) evade those restrictions while preserving T-duality?

sources.title: A New Class of de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the Large Volume Scenario support perturbatively metastable de Sitter vacua through small flux-induced supersymmetry breaking in the complex-structure/axio-dilaton sector, without an additional uplift sector?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization with positive vacuum energy

evidence.text: Can gauge-consistent anomalous-U(1) D terms or corrections to the Kahler potential uplift stabilized moduli vacua to zero or positive energy while allowing a TeV-scale gravitino?

sources.title: Racing through the swampland: de Sitter uplift vs weak gravity

evidence.text: Can a racetrack potential stabilize a type-IIB volume modulus strongly enough for controlled de Sitter uplift while its axionic partner satisfies a strong Weak Gravity Conjecture? The proposed connection concerns this stabilization mechanism and depends on the strength assigned to the conjecture.

sources.title: On Moduli Stabilisation and de Sitter Vacua in MSSM Heterotic Orbifolds

evidence.text: Can computable perturbative and nonperturbative effects stabilize all bulk moduli and produce metastable de Sitter vacua in explicit heterotic orbifolds containing the MSSM, once the coupled dynamics of all five complex bulk fields is retained?

sources.title: Constructing de Sitter vacua in no-scale string models without uplifting

evidence.text: Can the no-scale volume-moduli sector itself support metastable de Sitter vacua through F-term supersymmetry breaking, and how can the required superpotential be constructed without uplifting or no-scale-breaking Kähler corrections?

sources.title: Brane/antibrane dynamics and KKLT stability

evidence.text: Do antibrane backreaction, proposed decay channels, and objections to dimensional reduction invalidate KKLT metastable vacua, or can effective theories appropriate to each scale sustain the construction?

sources.title: Saltatory de Sitter string vacua

evidence.text: Can racetrack or full-instanton superpotentials extend KKLT moduli stabilization to multiple de Sitter vacua, and what can be inferred about their semiclassical stability?

sources.title: Global type IIA vacuum: A unified model for the standard model and cosmology

evidence.text: Can one globally embedded Type IIA intersecting-brane construction connect quark CP violation, instanton-induced lepton-number violation, leptogenesis, a small supersymmetry-breaking scale, and a metastable de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: Issues in type IIA uplifting

evidence.text: Can a positive F-term sector uplift stabilized AdS vacua of a simplified massive type IIA flux compactification to metastable de Sitter vacua with positive cosmological constant?

sources.title: S-track stabilization of heterotic de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can M5-instantons stabilize the heterotic M-theory volume modulus S together with the interval modulus T, producing de Sitter vacua with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking without multiple gaugino condensates?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in no-scale supergravities and Calabi-Yau string models

evidence.text: Which Kähler geometries and supersymmetry-breaking directions permit metastable Minkowski or de Sitter vacua generated by moduli F-terms, and can corrections lift geometric obstructions?

sources.title: A new de Sitter solution with a weakly warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: Can subdominant warping in the conifold-modulus Kähler metric support a new metastable de Sitter vacuum when the conifold deformation and bulk volume are stabilised together, and how well controlled is that vacuum?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Are omitted bulk and localized terms suppressed in hierarchical LVS, and can BPS charge–tension matching forbid candidate induced potentials?
